# pi-tach 0.1.0

Forked from [pi-glance](https://github.com/LinYS77/pi-glance) 0.7.7 (MIT), with the live speed display merged into the status line.

- **Live output speed** — the status line shows `⠇ 168.8 t/s` while the assistant streams and `✓ 168.8 t/s` when it finishes. The rate uses content-estimate deltas over ≥250 ms windows with an EMA, so it keeps moving while the provider reports usage only in its final chunk.
- **Fewer moving parts** — the separate tokens-per-second extension is no longer needed; Tokens, thinking counts and elapsed time stay out of the speed segment.
- **Unchanged elsewhere** — rounded editor, palettes, Git segments, prompt stash and `/tach` settings pane behave as in pi-glance.

Validated on Windows with Pi 1.4 and Node 22. The upstream test suite still runs here; a few upstream tests fail on Windows path handling both before and after this fork.
